# ManaTuner

> Free, open-source MTG mana-base calculator with model-based castability estimates, mana acceleration support, and a curated competitive library.

## Product contracts

- **Health Score**: heuristic average of turn-two access to each required fixed color or hybrid alternative group. It is not the percentage of spells cast on curve, a win probability, or a tournament-readiness certification. Shared bands: 85+ Excellent, 70–84 Good, 55–69 Average, below 55 Needs work.
- **Castability**: the default is an estimate. Exact modes enumerate only their stated supported resource and sequencing model; unsupported cases or exhausted work budgets do not produce an exact probability. Ramp estimates are not generally exact.
- **Mulligan**: defaults to 10,000 samples per kept-hand size, configurable to 50,000. London redraws seven, then bottoms cards after keeping. The model stops at four cards, uses heuristic bottoming and hand quality, and offers a free first mulligan in multiplayer mode. Bellman recursion optimizes the sampled reward model, not win rate.
- **Deck input**: supports explicit Deck, Sideboard and Commander sections, inline SB prefixes and supported export syntax. Blank-line separation is a legacy heuristic with warnings. Maybeboard and Companion are excluded from analysis. Commander identification requires an explicit marker or section.
- **Results**: Castability, Analysis, Mulligan, Manabase and Blueprint. Export PNG, PDF or JSON; compare saved analyses and explore post-board swaps.
- **Library**: curated articles, podcasts, videos and references. The live count is derived from the library data; lost and archived resources are labeled.

## Privacy and storage

Calculations and saved analyses stay in this browser. No account is required. Card lookups send names or identifiers to Scryfall; images, fonts and hosting use external services that receive connection metadata. A collection of looked-up names can reveal much of a deck. This is not a promise of zero transmission.

Sentry initializes only in a production build with a configured DSN. The privacy page shows the build's monitoring condition; this static document does not certify deployed settings. Legal requirements, redaction and actual payloads must be reviewed before activation.

Reset requests local deletion; IndexedDB cleanup is asynchronous and best effort. Reload to release memory caches. Shared links, exported files, browser history and third-party logs are not revoked or erased by Reset. See the privacy policy for details.
